body:
I can confirm this on 4.5.beta1 (Linux).

> the game silently exits with no console errors.

This is actually a crash; it just looks like it's existing silently since there's no visible feedback outside of the log file. See https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/61906.

My guess is that it's trying to create too many lines as part of the dashed line. There should be an upper limit where it just skips drawing new lines past that to avoid crashing (and print a warning when it happens). I'd probably set it to something like 4096.
